verdict.rationale: vLLM's documentation says it offers an official Docker image, vllm/vllm-openai on Docker Hub, built for deployment and able to run the OpenAI-compatible server. That is a first-party, container-based way to run the runtime for deployment, which covers the core of the story. missing for 10: documentation of versioned or pinned image tags that explicitly support reproducibility, and independent or hands-on corroboration that containerized deployment works.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the runtime inside a container for reproducible deployment

citations.quote: vLLM offers an official Docker image for deployment. The image can be used to run OpenAI compatible server and is available on Docker Hub as vllm/vllm-openai
